## 1. Bespoke Justification

- **Reason:** Economic-quality classification research study predicting asymmetric ordered-barrier target-before-stop outcomes (+1.00 ATR favorable vs 0.5/1.0/1.5 ATR adverse stops within 300s) on fully-forward 1s bars rather than binary regime flips.
- **Unsupported Element:** `Pure asymmetric ordered-barrier race target unconditioned on subsequent regime flip event`
- **Canonical Considered:** `flip_prediction`
- **Custom Scope:** `['implementation/target_before_stop_diagnostics.py', 'implementation/phase_d_modeling.py']`

---

## 2. Research Objective

NQ Regime-Transition Research Study 2. Evaluates whether causal information available at candidate time T discriminates regime-transition candidates whose subsequent path reaches a favorable target (+1.00 ATR) before hitting a predefined adverse stop (0.50, 1.00, 1.50 ATR) within 300 seconds on fully-forward sparse trade-bearing 1s LAST bars (1-SECOND-LAST-EXTERNAL).
